answers.rationale: This requirement pertains to compliance with specific standards for smart energy meters. It is not a product requirement but a compliance and regulatory matter, which the bid manager should address.

This requirement involves customer-specific standardization and technical specifications for meter boxes. It is a customization and compliance matter, not directly tied to a catalog product.

The requirement for a Network Management System (NMS) to monitor network elements and provide real-time performance and activity statistics aligns with the capabilities of the ANORD-PMS product, which includes power management and monitoring systems with SCADA and real-time monitoring capabilities.
